summary: Iteration 21: Comprehensive testing of Activity Log RESTRUCTURE feature. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%), 1 skipped (no training_session entries exist yet). All frontend UI components verified working correctly. The Activity Log now shows clean table with session-level entries only (training_session, feedback_session) with AI-generated impact summaries.
passed_tests: Response contains required pagination fields: entries, total, page, page_size, total_pages
Activity log only contains training_session and feedback_session entries (no url_added or file_uploaded)
POST /api/training/add-url no longer creates activity log entries
POST /api/feedback triggers feedback session aggregation after 5+ ratings from same device
Feedback session entry has correct structure: id, activity_type, timestamp, device_id, total_items, volume, rating_distribution, impact_summary
Feedback session volume shows rating breakdown format like '5 ratings (1x3, 2x4, 1x5, 1x6)'
Feedback session impact_summary is AI-generated text (not empty, not generic)
Frontend: Activity Log renders as a table with columns Timestamp, Device, Activity Type, Volume, Impact
Frontend: Activity Log card has data-testid='activity-log-card'
Frontend: Activity Log table has data-testid='activity-log-table'
Frontend: Feedback session row shows device ID (e.g., '71a24c'), cyan 'RATING FEEDBACK' badge, volume, and impact text
Frontend: All other components still present (Effectiveness Score, Training Queue, URL Input, Train button)
skipped_tests: Training session structure test - skipped because no training_session entries exist yet (need to run Train button to create one)
critical_code_review_comments: Activity log query correctly filters by activity_type: {'$in': ['training_session', 'feedback_session']}
FEEDBACK_SESSION_THRESHOLD = 5 correctly triggers session aggregation after 5+ ratings
_check_feedback_session runs as background task after each rating POST
Feedback session device_id correctly truncated to last 6 chars for privacy
rating_distribution uses str(k) for MongoDB compatibility (string keys required)
AI impact summary uses Claude Haiku via Emergent LLM Key with proper fallback
Volume format correctly shows breakdown: '5 ratings (1x3, 2x4, 1x5, 1x6)'
Frontend table correctly maps activity_type to display labels: training_session -> 'URL/Article Training', feedback_session -> 'Rating Feedback'
test_credentials: No credentials needed - app has no auth system
seed_data_creation: Created 5 feedback ratings from test device 'test-device-v21-*' to trigger feedback session aggregation
